outline: 本課程目標在提供學生英漢與漢英口譯專業訓練。課程內容含括專業逐步與同步口譯技巧，以及口譯過程與訓練的學術理論。重點將置於重述、記憶訓練、數字與語法轉換、筆記與跟述練習，以累積逐步與同步口譯技巧。

13   	Note-taking skills for CI: general topics II
14   	Note-taking Skills for CI: contemporary speeches I
15   	Note-taking Skills for CI: contemporary speeches II
16   	Interpreting: Theoretical perspectives I
17   	Interpreting: Theoretical perspectives II
18   	Final

Assessment

	30% on final examination
